"'''My Hearts Belong to You'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] performed by [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]], a [[Band/Legends|band]] formed<ref name="SWI 67" /> in the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Part 2">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> At some point before [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], the band's lead [[Musician/Legends|musician]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," including the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> his band made three recordings and a name for themselves with crowd-pleasers such as "My Hearts Belong to You." After Orbus's death, the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] was formed from the remaining band members,<ref name="SWI 67" /> and "My Hearts Belong to You" remained popular with the new band.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
"My Hearts Belong to You" was introduced in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI 67" /> which was published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later referred to the song as "My Heart Belongs to You."<ref name="CSWE" /> This article assumes the "My Hearts Belong to You" name from "Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band" is the correct song title.
